profiles.best_supported_use: internal historical anatomy only; do not use its published comparison as clean evidence
profiles.caveat: E1 is an input-stage micro-pipeline, not a full APHHM rerun
profiles.strength: historically preserves some low-prior candidates through a large search state
profiles.weakness: option-contaminated legacy input and repeated irreversible state writes prevent a clean architecture attribution

profiles.caveat: MCR favors Collapse3c over IMPC within its coherent family, but the DA-MCR interaction is not multiplicity-confirmed and no universal winner follows
profiles.strength: highest full-800 clinical-complete rate (122/800, 15.25%); retains causal, anatomical, temporal, stage, and composite qualifiers
profiles.weakness: specificity retention is offset by generation misses and catastrophic substitutions; no overall complete contrast is multiplicity-confirmed

profiles.best_supported_use: proposal diversity source, not a default final selector
profiles.caveat: profile is frozen-output anatomy, not a fresh head-to-head intervention
profiles.strength: second-highest full-800 clinical-complete rate (121/800, 15.12%) and the highest safe-exact lower bound (8.62%)
profiles.weakness: its 21 complete gains over Collapse3c are offset by 22 losses; wider correlated competition has essentially zero net complete effect

profiles.caveat: not demonstrated universally superior; chosen because the proposed replacement failed
profiles.strength: simple, reliable two-proposal plus comparator path; preserves broader frontier exposure and beats current RCR-3
profiles.weakness: full-800 clinical-complete is 106/800 (13.25%), below Collapse3c, and many outputs remain parent/component partials

profiles.best_supported_use: evidence-integration comparator pattern after exact identity repair
profiles.caveat: fixed-pool selector advantage is not a complete Forest architecture win
profiles.strength: best fixed-pool evidence integration in E4, useful residual view capture, and the highest complete-or-compatible-partial coverage in E2 (48.25%)
profiles.weakness: its high legacy-chain rate (26.62%) does not imply clinical completeness (13.38%); stable-parent preference, repeated views, and unsafe substring identity compress scope

profiles.best_supported_use: canonical-family proposal signal, not full-object endpoint leader
profiles.caveat: Collapse3c-to-IMPC is -3.00pp overall (q=.070843) and -5.50pp in MCR (q=.045615); the family interaction is not confirmed (q=.228489)
profiles.strength: broad stable family recognition and 19 object rescues relative to Collapse3c in the full-800 transition audit
profiles.weakness: legacy-chain is 26.50% but clinical-complete only 12.25%; 32 catastrophic substitutions and 17 scope compressions outweigh those rescues

profiles.best_supported_use: retain proposal coverage and one explicit comparator; retire S1 as sole source
profiles.caveat: E7 complete advantage over v0 is a mechanism signal, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmation
profiles.strength: occasionally recovers rare specific entities; raw fixed-pool comparison can improve its historical first-candidate result
profiles.weakness: S1 deletes decisive relations, safe width has low marginal capture, and extra selector samples are not identifiable depth gains

profiles.caveat: full-census historical outputs remain development data; v0 is not the lowest arm on every endpoint
profiles.strength: small/simple state offers a useful minimal baseline
profiles.weakness: clinical-complete is 12.88% and task 40.12%; e7 loses 21 complete cases but rescues only 11 when replaced by v0

profiles.best_supported_use: rank-propagation mechanism, not an independent multi-expert panel
profiles.caveat: current-sample ranking gain and long-tail capture harm coexist
profiles.strength: sequential history converts already-exposed candidates; E2 shows 32 complete rescues versus B07 and E10 isolates rank propagation
profiles.weakness: B07 simultaneously rescues 28 cases, while history nearly eliminates D3 novelty and can erase rare correct minority opinions

profiles.best_supported_use: no-retrieval draft plus typed, gated retrieval research control
profiles.caveat: E11 tests the realised TF-IDF bundle, not ideal RAG
profiles.strength: highest partial rate (35.25%) and frequent soft landing in a compatible disease family
profiles.weakness: clinical-complete is only 12.62%; current lexical retrieval is weakly relevant and generic refine may delete rare candidates

profiles.best_supported_use: falsified research prototype; mine validated components only
profiles.caveat: failure of this generated implementation is not failure of all constrained relational systems
profiles.strength: safe-exact identity, explicit typed composite proposals, original-span intent, and a testable three-stage contract
profiles.weakness: span drops, relation errors, schema failures, fixed frontier losses, requested-object leakage, and severe self-calibration error

profiles.caveat: its ITA loss is largely reliability-mediated
profiles.strength: tests whether a genuine additional independent subtype view adds value beyond Lite
